name: io.github.ArtyMcLabin/Gmail-MCP-Server
description: Gmail MCP server with auto authentication support

environmentVariables.description: Path to your Google OAuth client keys file. Optional — defaults to ~/.gmail-mcp/gcp-oauth.keys.json.
environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_OAUTH_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Path where OAuth tokens are stored after authentication. Optional — defaults to ~/.gmail-mcp/credentials.json.
environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_PATH
